notes.title: New VJmachine Version 2.0 available now
notes.content:
einklang.VISUAL proudly presents VJmachine Version 2.0 

New Features & Updates included in Version 2.0:

> New Feature Music Video Creation e.g. YouTube 
   Menu botton "Record"
   1) Select MP3 or OGG file for sound
   2) Select file name and folder for MPG
   3) Make your Scene, Video, Pic, ... selections
   4) Start Recording 
   5) Change selectionduring recording

> New Feature In-App Sound Source Selection
   Menu botton "Config" switch between sound sources

> F11 for Screenshots

> Improved Music Analyzes 
> Usability Improvements
> New Content 
> Bug Fixes e.g. Slideshow

First official Music Video created with VJmachine: https://youtu.be/fcZb2nc0Kjs

More Videos will follow...

Share your Music Video creations with us and celebrate the Upgrade 🖖

notes.title: New Release Features & Fixes
notes.content:
Hi,

The new release will come in the next two weeks will  include following features:

- Video Recording 
- Sound Input Selection in App
- F11 key for full screen 

and a fix for:

- Slideshow problem

A preview of the Video Recording feature will be available in the next days as video on our community page. 

Stay tuned and share your thoughts.

Kind Regards
VJmachine Development
